description: This file defines a Settings class for managing application settings in the Notesnook project, including default values, storage, and retrieval methods, as well as related types and constants.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A class for managing application settings, including default values, persistence, and retrieval.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a setting value by key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a setting value by key, returning default if not set.

methods.name: getGroupOptions
methods.description: Gets grouping options for a specified section.

methods.name: setGroupOptions
methods.description: Sets grouping options for a specified section.

methods.name: setToolbarConfig
methods.description: Sets toolbar configuration for a specified platform.

methods.name: getToolbarConfig
methods.description: Gets toolbar configuration for a specified platform.

methods.name: getSideBarOrder
methods.description: Gets the order of sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: setSideBarOrder
methods.description: Sets the order of sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: getSideBarHiddenItems
methods.description: Gets hidden sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: setSideBarHiddenItems
methods.description: Sets hidden sidebar items for a section.

methods.name: setProfile
methods.description: Updates the user profile with partial data.
